tuple.meaningZh: 结势垒；半导体结处的势垒
tuple.en: The semiconductor diagram marks the junction barrier.
tuple.zh: 半导体图标出了结势垒。

entries.notes: 纠正旧草稿把该词与无插头电缆连接器混淆的失败义项，不复用失败句。

tuple.en: The review explains why ketosis-prone diabetes is not a single uniform condition.
tuple.zh: 综述解释了为何易发酮症型糖尿病不是一种单一均一的病况。

tuple.meaningZh: lady's slipper：兜兰或杓兰等具有囊状唇瓣的兰花；不是凤仙花
tuple.en: The lady's slipper opened a pouch-shaped flower beside the woodland path.
tuple.zh: 林间小路旁，那株杓兰开出了一朵囊状的花。

tuple.en: The art lesson explains linear perspective.
tuple.zh: 美术课解释了线性透视法。

tuple.en: The firm kept enough liquid assets to meet its immediate bills.
tuple.zh: 公司保有足够的流动资产以支付近期账单。

tuple.meaningZh: 液量计量；液体容量单位
tuple.en: The recipe book includes a table of liquid measure for cups and millilitres.
tuple.zh: 食谱附有杯与毫升之间的液量换算表。

tuple.en: The spa’s old menu lists lithia water.
tuple.zh: 温泉疗养地的旧饮品单列出了含锂矿泉水。

tuple.en: The caretaker is required to live in.
tuple.zh: 管理员被要求住在工作地点。

tuple.meaningZh: 生命物质；构成活细胞的物质（泛称）
tuple.en: The microscope revealed tiny droplets of living substance moving inside the cell.
tuple.zh: 显微镜显示，细胞内有微小的生命物质液滴在移动。

tuple.en: A Maltese cross was engraved on the button.
tuple.zh: 纽扣上刻着马耳他十字图案。

tuple.en: The display includes a carved imitation of a mandrake root.
tuple.zh: 展品包括一个曼德拉草根的雕刻仿制品。

tuple.en: A mare's tail stretched across the pale evening sky.
tuple.zh: 一条马尾状卷云横伸在淡色的暮空中。

tuple.en: An oak fern spread its fronds beneath the birches.
tuple.zh: 一株欧亚羽节蕨在桦树下舒展叶片。

tuple.en: She wore an olive brown coat.
tuple.zh: 她穿着一件橄榄褐色外套。

tuple.meaningZh: 胰腺纤维化；胰腺中纤维组织增多，不等同于囊性纤维化这一病名
tuple.en: The pathology report described pancreatic fibrosis in the tissue sample.
tuple.zh: 病理报告描述了组织样本中的胰腺纤维化。

tuple.en: The specification calls for pit run gravel.
tuple.zh: 规格说明要求使用未筛分砾石。

tuple.en: The interview with a primordial dwarf focused on accessible transport.
tuple.zh: 对一位原始性侏儒症患者的访谈聚焦于无障碍交通。

tuple.meaningZh: proto-的无连字符形式；原始的；最早的；前期的
tuple.en: Proto- in proto-language points to an earlier ancestral language.
tuple.zh: proto-language中的proto-指向更早的祖语。

tuple.en: A purging cassia grew beside the garden entrance.
tuple.zh: 一棵腊肠树生长在花园入口旁。

tuple.en: The band marched across the square in quick time.
tuple.zh: 乐队以齐步速度走过广场。

tuple.meaningZh: 绯红肉杯菌；具有鲜红色杯状子实体的一类真菌俗名
tuple.en: A scarlet cup stood out against the dark, decaying wood.
tuple.zh: 一朵绯红肉杯菌在深色的腐木上格外醒目。

tuple.en: The guide groups tuna with other scombroid fish.
tuple.zh: 图鉴把金枪鱼与其他鲭形鱼类归在一起。

tuple.meaningZh: 片状闪电；标准形式sheet lightning
tuple.en: Sheet lightning lit the distant clouds.
tuple.zh: 片状闪电照亮了远处的云。

tuple.meaningZh: 石色灯草鹀；暗眼灯草鹀的石色类型
tuple.en: A slate-colored junco searched for seeds beneath the feeder.
tuple.zh: 一只石色灯草鹀在喂鸟器下方寻找种子。

tuple.en: The small businessman knew most of his customers.
tuple.zh: 这位小企业经营者认识大多数顾客。

tuple.en: We finally reached solid ground.
tuple.zh: 我们终于到达了坚实的地面。

tuple.meaningZh: 短纤维；具有有限长度的纺织纤维，可以是天然或人造的
tuple.en: The mill blends staple fiber before spinning it into yarn.
tuple.zh: 工厂先把短纤维混合，再把它们纺成纱线。

tuple.en: The brain diagram labels a striate vein.
tuple.zh: 脑部图标出了一条纹状体静脉。

tuple.meaningZh: 鮣鱼；头部有吸盘的海鱼
tuple.en: The photograph shows a sucking fish attached to a larger fish.
tuple.zh: 照片显示一条鮣鱼附着在一条较大的鱼身上。

tuple.en: The suction pump drew water out of the flooded cellar.
tuple.zh: 抽吸泵把水从被淹的地下室抽了出来。

tuple.meaningZh: 沼泽山核桃；所给植物俗名
tuple.en: A swamp hickory stood near the wet ground.
tuple.zh: 一棵沼泽山核桃立在湿地附近。

tuple.en: The old invoice specifies Swedish iron.
tuple.zh: 旧发票注明使用瑞典熟铁。

tuple.en: The botanist pressed a sweet wormwood specimen for the herbarium.
tuple.zh: 植物学家把一份青蒿标本压制好，供植物标本馆收藏。

tuple.en: The technician found a fault in the tape transport.
tuple.zh: 技术员发现了磁带传送机构的一处故障。

tuple.meaningZh: 塔塔酱；一种配鱼食用的调味酱
tuple.en: He asked for tartar sauce with the fish.
tuple.zh: 他要了塔塔酱配鱼。

tuple.meaningZh: tera-：国际单位制词头，表示10的12次方，即万亿倍
tuple.en: Tera- makes one terawatt equal to a trillion watts.
tuple.zh: 词头tera-使一太瓦等于一万亿瓦。

entries.author: AI/prepare-author-selfcheck

tuple.meaningZh: 胸腺核酸的旧名称thymic acid
tuple.en: The history of chemistry explains thymic acid as an older nucleic-acid name.
tuple.zh: 化学史把thymic acid解释为胸腺核酸的旧名称。

entries.notes: 明确所选历史核酸命名语境，不混作现代胸腺嘧啶核苷酸。

tuple.en: The museum photograph shows a tiger snake near the reeds.
tuple.zh: 博物馆照片显示一条芦苇附近的虎蛇。

tuple.meaningZh: 氧化钛；常指二氧化钛，但具体化学式须依上下文确定
tuple.en: The pigment supplier identified the titanium oxide as titanium dioxide.
tuple.zh: 颜料供应商确认，这种氧化钛是二氧化钛。

tuple.en: A toggle switch protruded from the radio’s side.
tuple.zh: 收音机侧面伸出一个拨动开关。

tuple.en: She packed her toilet articles in a small bag.
tuple.zh: 她把洗漱用品装进小袋子里。

tuple.meaningZh: 符号货币；面值大于其材料本身价值的货币
tuple.en: The lecture contrasted token money with coins valued mainly for their metal.
tuple.zh: 这堂课将符号货币与主要按金属本身计价的硬币作了对比。

tuple.en: The old bridge became a tourist attraction.
tuple.zh: 旧桥成了旅游景点。

tuple.en: A tractor-trailer waited at the loading bay.
tuple.zh: 一辆半挂牵引车在装卸区等候。

tuple.meaningZh: 高音谱表；使用高音谱号的五线谱表
tuple.en: The melody is written on the treble staff above the bass part.
tuple.zh: 旋律写在低音声部上方的高音谱表上。

tuple.en: A tree fern shaded the path.
tuple.zh: 一株树蕨给小路遮阴。

tuple.en: They used a trial-and-error approach to arrange the shelves.
tuple.zh: 他们用反复试错的方法摆放架子。

tuple.meaningZh: 姜黄根茎；烹饪上常称姜黄根，不是白毛茛
tuple.en: She grated fresh turmeric root into the soup.
tuple.zh: 她把新鲜姜黄根茎擦成碎末，放进汤里。

tuple.en: The tool museum displays a two-handed saw.
tuple.zh: 工具博物馆展出了一把双人拉锯。

tuple.en: The field guide includes a photograph of unicorn root in flower.
tuple.zh: 野外指南包括一张独角根开花的照片。

tuple.meaningZh: 高地鹬；upland sandpiper的旧名，虽名plover但并非鸻科鸟
tuple.en: The old field guide lists the upland plover among grassland birds.
tuple.zh: 那本旧野外指南把高地鹬列为草原鸟类。

tuple.en: The laboratory report records a vaginal smear.
tuple.zh: 实验室报告记录了一项阴道涂片检查。

tuple.meaningZh: 升降速度表；所选航空义
tuple.en: The glider pilot checked the variometer.
tuple.zh: 滑翔机飞行员查看了升降速度表。

tuple.meaningZh: 黄绿色的；略带黄色的绿色
tuple.en: The young leaves were yellowish green when they first opened.
tuple.zh: 嫩叶刚展开时呈黄绿色。

tuple.en: The archive collects personal accounts of COVID-19.
tuple.zh: 档案收集了关于2019冠状病毒病的个人记述。

tuple.en: The hall’s acoustics made every whispered word audible.
tuple.zh: 大厅的声学特性让每一句低语都能听见。

tuple.meaningZh: 为说法提供证据或支持
tuple.en: Can you back your claim up with figures from the report?
tuple.zh: 你能用报告中的数据来支持你的说法吗？

tuple.meaningZh: 获得某人的好感或认可
tuple.en: He was in his aunt’s good books after fixing the gate.
tuple.zh: 修好大门后，他赢得了姑妈的好感。

tuple.en: He blew his chance by missing the interview.
tuple.zh: 他因错过面试而失去了机会。

tuple.meaningZh: 做好心理准备；使自己振作以迎接困难
tuple.en: I braced myself before opening the letter with the examination result.
tuple.zh: 拆开装着考试结果的信之前，我先做好了心理准备。

tuple.en: A ringing phone broke the spell.
tuple.zh: 电话铃打破了令人入迷的气氛。

tuple.en: She changed her tune when she saw the full cost.
tuple.zh: 她看到全部费用后改了口。

tuple.en: His wish to travel collided with his need to save money.
tuple.zh: 他想去旅行的愿望与攒钱的需要发生了冲突。

tuple.en: The cost of the mistake finally came home to him.
tuple.zh: 他终于深切意识到了错误的代价。

tuple.en: He found it difficult to confide in his brother.
tuple.zh: 他发现很难向兄弟倾诉。

tuple.meaningZh: 妨碍某人自在表现；使某人放不开手脚
tuple.en: Having my manager watch every step really cramps my style.
tuple.zh: 经理盯着我的一举一动，实在让我放不开手脚。

tuple.en: It dawned on me that I had the wrong address.
tuple.zh: 我开始明白自己拿错了地址。

tuple.en: By hiding the problem, you may do her a disservice.
tuple.zh: 隐瞒问题可能反而对她不利。

tuple.meaningZh: 反复追问，才从某人口中问出某事
tuple.en: We had to drag the full story out of him one detail at a time.
tuple.zh: 我们只好一个细节一个细节地追问，才从他口中问出事情的全部经过。

tuple.en: I feel like taking a walk.
tuple.zh: 我想散散步。

tuple.en: It was unfair of them to gang up on the newest member.
tuple.zh: 他们联合起来对付最新成员，这不公平。

tuple.meaningZh: 终于抽出时间或着手做原先打算做的事
tuple.en: I finally got round to repairing the loose door handle.
tuple.zh: 我终于抽出时间修好了松动的门把手。

tuple.en: His dismissive tone got her back up.
tuple.zh: 他轻蔑的语气惹恼了她。

tuple.meaningZh: 受到某人的批评或取笑
tuple.en: He got stick from his friends for forgetting the tickets.
tuple.zh: 他因忘记带票遭到朋友们的取笑。

tuple.term: get to the bottom of something
tuple.meaningZh: 查明真相；弄清根本原因
tuple.en: The engineer checked every connection to get to the bottom of the fault.
tuple.zh: 工程师检查了每个连接点，以查明故障的根本原因。

tuple.meaningZh: 泄露某人的秘密；暴露某人
tuple.en: His accent gave him away.
tuple.zh: 他的口音暴露了他。

tuple.meaningZh: 增加某事的分量或说服力
tuple.en: The new evidence gives weight to her explanation.
tuple.zh: 新证据使她的解释更有说服力。

tuple.meaningZh: 受到某人欢迎；得到良好反应
tuple.en: The shorter working week went down well with the staff.
tuple.zh: 缩短工作周的安排很受员工欢迎。

tuple.term: go out of one's way to do something
tuple.en: She went out of her way to help the new student.
tuple.zh: 她特意费心帮助新学生。

tuple.en: The possibility of losing the house hung over them all winter.
tuple.zh: 整个冬天，可能失去房子的阴影一直笼罩着他们。

tuple.meaningZh: 指责、数落或冲某人发火
tuple.en: Please do not have a go at her before you hear what happened.
tuple.zh: 在听清事情经过之前，请别责骂她。

tuple.term: have a keen eye for something
tuple.en: He has a keen eye for small details.
tuple.zh: 他善于发现细节。

tuple.en: You need to have your wits about you in this busy market.
tuple.zh: 在这个繁忙市场里，你需要保持机警。

tuple.meaningZh: 面临艰巨任务；得费很大劲才能完成
tuple.en: With half the team absent, we had our work cut out finishing the order.
tuple.zh: 团队有一半人缺席，我们得费很大劲才能完成这份订单。

tuple.en: I have reservations about the new timetable.
tuple.zh: 我对新时刻表有所保留。

tuple.en: I thought he was having me on until I saw the letter.
tuple.zh: 看到那封信之前，我以为他在拿我开玩笑。

tuple.en: I disagreed with him, but I heard him out before replying.
tuple.zh: 我虽然不同意他的观点，还是听他把话说完才作答。

tuple.meaningZh: 因某事责怪或记恨某人
tuple.en: Please do not hold the delay against her.
tuple.zh: 请不要因这次延误而责怪她。

tuple.en: The new schedule impinges on her family time.
tuple.zh: 新日程影响了她与家人相处的时间。

tuple.meaningZh: 猛然使某人从某种状态中惊醒
tuple.en: A sharp knock jerked me out of a pleasant daydream.
tuple.zh: 一阵急促的敲门声把我从愉快的白日梦中惊醒。

tuple.en: Her friends kept her afloat during the difficult month.
tuple.zh: 在那艰难的一个月里，朋友们帮助她撑了下去。

tuple.en: The organisers tried to keep the rival groups apart.
tuple.zh: 组织者试图让对立的两组人保持分开。

tuple.meaningZh: 瞒着某人；不让某人知道有关情况
tuple.en: They kept the volunteers in the dark about the change of venue.
tuple.zh: 他们没有把更换地点的事告诉志愿者。

tuple.en: The unexpected question knocked him off balance.
tuple.zh: 意外的问题让他措手不及。

tuple.meaningZh: 在困难时丢下某人不管
tuple.en: He left us in the lurch by cancelling at the last minute.
tuple.zh: 他临时取消，把我们撇在困难之中。

tuple.term: make a song and dance about something
tuple.meaningZh: 对某事大做文章；小题大做
tuple.en: He made a song and dance about a delay of only five minutes.
tuple.zh: 不过耽搁了五分钟，他却对此大做文章。

tuple.en: We had to make do with two chairs.
tuple.zh: 我们只好将就着用两把椅子。

tuple.en: I do not have the faintest idea where the key is.
tuple.zh: 我一点也不知道钥匙在哪里。

tuple.meaningZh: 指出某人的错误；责问或纠正某人
tuple.en: The tutor pulled me up on a quotation I had copied incorrectly.
tuple.zh: 导师指出了我抄错的一处引文。

tuple.en: Are you pulling my leg?
tuple.zh: 你是在开我玩笑吗？

tuple.en: She never puts on airs despite her success.
tuple.zh: 尽管很成功，她从不摆架子。

tuple.en: She put the missing files down to a mistake during the move.
tuple.zh: 她把文件丢失归因于搬迁时的一次失误。

tuple.en: She could not put her finger on the cause.
tuple.zh: 她无法准确指出原因。

tuple.meaningZh: 使自己接受不愿面对的事实
tuple.en: He slowly reconciled himself to the delay.
tuple.zh: 他慢慢接受了延误这一事实。

tuple.meaningZh: 看穿伪装、借口或不真诚的表现
tuple.en: The children saw through his excuse and asked for a proper explanation.
tuple.zh: 孩子们看穿了他的借口，要求他好好解释。

tuple.en: Please spell the instructions out for the new volunteers.
tuple.zh: 请把指示给新志愿者详细讲清楚。

tuple.en: She stared daggers at the man who had spoiled the ending.
tuple.zh: 她狠狠瞪着那个剧透结局的男人。

tuple.meaningZh: 看某人的反应来决定行动；以某人的举动为信号
tuple.en: I took my cue from the host and stood when the guests entered.
tuple.zh: 我照着主人的举动，在客人进来时站了起来。

entries.author: AI/prepare-author-selfcheck

tuple.en: He took his younger sister into his confidence.
tuple.zh: 他把私事告诉了妹妹。

entries.notes: EN sister未限年龄，ZH使用妹妹为具体原创人物设定，语义需对应older/younger。

tuple.en: I needed a moment to take the news in.
tuple.zh: 我需要一点时间来消化这个消息。

tuple.meaningZh: 误会某人的话或用意；把话听成冒犯
tuple.en: I meant to help, but he took my suggestion the wrong way.
tuple.zh: 我本来想帮忙，他却误会了我的建议。

tuple.en: The children took to their heels when the rain began.
tuple.zh: 雨一下，孩子们就拔腿跑了。

tuple.en: We should think the plan through before spending any money.
tuple.zh: 我们应该在花钱之前把计划仔细想清楚。

tuple.term: toy with the idea of doing something
tuple.meaningZh: 随意考虑做某事；有过念头但尚未认真决定
tuple.en: She toyed with the idea of opening a small bookshop by the sea.
tuple.zh: 她曾动过在海边开一家小书店的念头。

tuple.meaningZh: 不断牵动某事；反复拉扯
tuple.en: The familiar melody tugged away at his memory.
tuple.zh: 熟悉的旋律不断牵动着他的记忆。

tuple.en: He went outside to walk his frustration off.
tuple.zh: 他出去走走，缓解心中的沮丧。

tuple.meaningZh: 使某人筋疲力尽；耗尽体力或精力
tuple.en: Looking after the stall all day wore us out.
tuple.zh: 照看了一整天摊位，我们累得筋疲力尽。

tuple.en: She weighed the stranger up before answering.
tuple.zh: 她先打量了陌生人，才作答。
